decisions.why: Avoid overriding global input/label styles used elsewhere in the page while still matching the spec-required look for the contact form.

decisions.what: Rebuilt the existing contact section markup to match the spec (id='contact-form', field ids name/email/company/message, submit-btn, form-message)
decisions.why: The pre-existing markup used different ids and classes; the spec requires exact ids (name, email, company, message) so JS validation and CSS hooks work as described.

decisions.what: Applied .skeleton animation to the submit button while loading and added a .btn-text span for reliable text swapping
decisions.why: The spec calls for a skeleton loading state on the button during submission and morphing text; wrapping the label lets JS swap text/icons without destroying event handlers.

decisions.what: Kept Formspree endpoint as the placeholder 'https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID' from the spec
decisions.why: Spec explicitly states to use that URL and notes it should be replaced with an actual Formspree ID by the site owner; hardcoding a real one is out of scope.
